title: Auto Loans: Fee Waivers
content:
Fees on Auto Loans accounts can be waived at Piedmont Crescent Bank for one of two reasons, bank error or courtesy. This policy defines both and the conditions each carries.

## General rule

A fee is only ever waived whole, never in part, by a single waiver entry that names the fee being waived. No fee can be waived more than once; whether a waiver already names the fee is read from the loan's activity. When the fee being waived had already been paid out of a payment, the waived amount is given back by applying it to principal on the day of the waiver, within that same waiver entry.

## Bank-error waivers

A bank-error waiver covers any fee that was charged contrary to the Auto Loans rules, for example a late charge on an installment that was in fact satisfied inside the state grace period, a late charge above the state's limit or percentage, a late charge on an installment deferred by an extension, or a second late charge on one installment. Bank-error waivers have no numeric limit.

## Courtesy waivers

A courtesy waiver can be given only for a late charge; it is never given for an extension fee or a returned payment fee. All of the following must hold, each read from the bank's records:

- **Allowance.** The customer's courtesy waivers of late charges in the rolling 365 days ending today, counted across every auto loan the customer has, number fewer than the product's courtesy allowance.
- **On-time record.** The installments immediately preceding the late one show an unbroken run of on-time installments at least as long as the product requires. The run is counted backwards, most recent first, from the latest due date before today; an installment is on time when scheduled payments credited toward its due date reached the monthly payment within the state grace days, and the count stops at the first installment that was not.
- **Loan status.** The loan is active or delinquent at the time of the courtesy waiver.

## Scope of each waiver reason

| Waiver reason | Fees it can cover | Numeric limit | Further conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank error | any fee charged contrary to the Auto Loans rules | none | none beyond the fee having been charged contrary to the rules |
| Courtesy | late charges only | the product's courtesy allowance per customer in a rolling 365 days | the on-time run and the loan status described above |

Under either reason the whole fee is waived, and a fee that already has a waiver cannot receive another.
